rules.requirement: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.

assertingTests.name: the Philosopher gains the chosen ability and drunks its owner (SNV-PHILOSOPHER-01)
a first-night-only ability borrowed on a later night works that night (SNV-PHILOSOPHER-01)
a Philosopher who borrowed the Klutz still makes the public choice after dying (SNV-PHILOSOPHER-01)
a character the Philosopher chose while absent is created later and its holder is drunk (SNV-PHILOSOPHER-01, SNV-PITHAG-01)
a role correction that creates the Philosopher's chosen character drunks its holder (SNV-PHILOSOPHER-01)
a Philosopher who gains an information ability wakes for it in its slot, at once for a first-night ability on a later night, and from the next night when gained on the first (SNV-PHILOSOPHER-01)

rules.requirement: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.

assertingTests.name: a Philosopher who borrowed the Juggler guesses on their first day with it (SNV-PHILOSOPHER-02)
a Philosopher who borrowed the Klutz records the public choice (SNV-PHILOSOPHER-02)
a borrowed day ability acts and a Drunk's shown one does not (SNV-PHILOSOPHER-02)
